[merged-gpt-6-luna-atleast2of3]
[final-gpt-6-luna-effort-high-run1]
The BCM Data Exports service must be authorized by the destination bucket policy before this export is created. This export references the bucket but does not depend on the policy that grants the service access, so creation can fail if it runs first.

----------------------------------------

[final-gpt-6-luna-effort-high-run2]
The BCM data export must wait for the S3 bucket policy granting bcm-data-exports.amazonaws.com permission to write to the destination bucket; the bucket reference alone does not order policy creation before export creation.

----------------------------------------

[final-gpt-6-luna-effort-high-run3]
The BCM Data Export writes to this bucket through the AWS billing export service, and the configured bucket policy grants that service its required access. Ensure the policy is attached before creating the export; currently the export references only the bucket, not its policy.

----------------------------------------

[merged-deepseek-v4.1-flash-1017-atleast2of3]
[final-deepseek-v4.1-flash-1017-effort-high-run1]
aws_bcmdataexports_export.cur_per_resource only depends on the bucket itself, so it can be created before aws_s3_bucket_policy.cur_bucket_policy. The BCM Data Exports service validates the destination bucket policy at export creation time (the policy's EnableAWSDataExportsToWriteToS3AndCheckPolicy statement grants bcm-data-exports.amazonaws.com s3:PutObject/s3:GetBucketPolicy), so the export must be ordered after the bucket policy or creation fails with a bucket-policy validation error.

----------------------------------------

[final-deepseek-v4.1-flash-1017-effort-high-run2]
`aws_bcmdataexports_export.cur_per_resource` writes CUR/BCM parquet files into the billing-report bucket, but AWS validates the destination bucket policy when the export is created (the export creation performs a bucket-policy permission check for the `bcm-data-exports.amazonaws.com` service principal). The resource currently only depends on `aws_s3_bucket.aws_billing_report`, so on a fresh apply the export can be created before `aws_s3_bucket_policy.cur_bucket_policy` exists (the statement granting `s3:PutObject`/`s3:GetBucketPolicy` to `billingreports.amazonaws.com` and `bcm-data-exports.amazonaws.com`), which makes export creation fail. It needs an explicit ordering dependency on the bucket policy.

----------------------------------------

[final-deepseek-v4.1-flash-1017-effort-high-run3]
aws_bcmdataexports_export.cur_per_resource delivers its export to the billing bucket, and the BCM Data Exports service validates the destination bucket's resource policy when the export is created (s3:PutObject and s3:GetBucketPolicy for bcm-data-exports.amazonaws.com — the statement declared as EnableAWSDataExportsToWriteToS3AndCheckPolicy). The export only depends on aws_s3_bucket.aws_billing_report, so on a fresh apply it can be created before aws_s3_bucket_policy.cur_bucket_policy exists and the API call fails. Add an explicit depends_on (no attribute of aws_s3_bucket_policy can be substituted for s3_bucket).

----------------------------------------

[merged-glm-5.3-flash-atleast2of3]
[final-glm-5.3-flash-effort-high-run1]
aws_bcmdataexports_export.cur_per_resource delivers to s3_bucket aws_s3_bucket.aws_billing_report, but no dependency (attribute or depends_on) links it to aws_s3_bucket_policy.cur_bucket_policy, which grants bcm-data-exports.amazonaws.com permission to write (s3:PutObject, s3:GetBucketPolicy, with aws:SourceArn conditions). AWS validates destination bucket access at export-creation time; if the export is created before the policy is attached, the apply can fail with an AccessDenied/validation error — or, per the upstream provider bug noted in the code comments, the export gets created in AWS while the apply fails, requiring a manual import. Add depends_on = [aws_s3_bucket_policy.cur_bucket_policy] (no attribute on the export can reference the policy, so a bare depends_on is the idiomatic fix here).

----------------------------------------

[final-glm-5.3-flash-effort-high-run2]
aws_bcmdataexports_export.cur_per_resource writes to aws_s3_bucket.aws_billing_report but has no dependency on aws_s3_bucket_policy.cur_bucket_policy. BCM Data Exports validates at creation time that the destination bucket policy allows bcm-data-exports.amazonaws.com to write; if the export is created before the bucket policy is applied, CreateExport fails. No attribute of the export can reference the policy, so an explicit depends_on is required.

----------------------------------------

[final-glm-5.3-flash-effort-high-run3]
aws_bcmdataexports_export.cur_per_resource writes to aws_s3_bucket.aws_billing_report, but BCM Data Exports validates that the destination bucket policy grants access to bcm-data-exports.amazonaws.com at export-creation time. The bucket policy (aws_s3_bucket_policy.cur_bucket_policy) must exist before the export is created; no attribute reference or depends_on currently expresses this ordering, so a first apply can fail with Access Denied.
